mutant_kills.M1-accept-on-drift: g-exit3-content-drift red (2/3 held), in-place --root and committed --rev
mutant_kills.M2-wrong-code: g-exit3-content-drift red (2/3 held), in-place --root and committed --rev

loopholes: mutant arm credited by pre-existing receipt-revision-gate-selftest row or selftest-in-disguise row (measured red under M1-M3)
prefix needle RECEIPT_REV and generic needle verdict=REFUSED leave M2 alive (weak needles held 2/2 under M2)
code-truth arm vacuous when table names no code: 0 RECEIPT tokens, all() True
code-truth 'defined' by text grep cannot distinguish emitted from docstring (4 occurrences in base and M1)
empty --paths file yields RECEIPT_REV_CONTENT_DRIFT with a no-paths detail; SKILL row 2 parenthetical is true only for an absent flag
unresolvable listed path is reported as drift (<unresolvable-path:P>); a counter fixture with a bogus path proves nothing
row locator ambiguous: row 2 also contains --paths; locate row 1 by exact first cell

proposed_rewrites.skill_line_53: | a verdict receipt names another revision | refused unless its bytes equal the certified revision on the declared `--paths` surface; with no `--paths` the code is `RECEIPT_REV_MISMATCH` | `RECEIPT_REV_CONTENT_DRIFT` |
proposed_rewrites.counter_gate_admission: kind gate, status active, argv[0] in {python3,python}, argv[1]=='tools/receipt-revision-gate.py', '--selftest' absent, no -c/-m
proposed_rewrites.counter_needles: exit 3 rows need an element equal to a CODES member; exit 2 rows need RECEIPT_REV_UNRESOLVABLE
proposed_rewrites.counter_mutant_route: fresh git clone --shared at REV, one in-place replacement asserted count==1, git status lists only the gate, registry-check run from the mutant clone with the REV registry; or commit the mutant and use --rev
proposed_rewrites.counter_code_truth: row located by exact first cell; code cell equals emitted code exactly; >=4 rows and >=4 tokens; CODES via ast; every token in CODES
proposed_rewrites.gate_probe_row: Name receipt-revision-gate; Verdict map cell contains 0, 2, 3 as exits and RECEIPT_REV_UNRESOLVABLE
